This portfolio aims to play around with Shiny apps. In this app, I hope to have the user select a mood and receive a list of songs, video games, youtubers, and/or things to do while they feel like this. The main goal is to make a app that gives me a list of things to do during certain moods. I often forget the things I have access to when I'm in certain moods and this may be a fun tool to use to mitigate that fatigue. 

```{r}

library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)

ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Mood-Based Recommendations"),
  
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      selectInput("mood", "How are you feeling?", 
                  choices = c("Bed-Rotting", "Irritated", "Hyper", "Chill", "Anxious"))
    ),
    
    mainPanel(
      h3("Recommendations for you:"),
      uiOutput("recommendations")
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output) {
  output$recommendations <- renderUI({
    
    # Use switch to change content based on input$mood
    content <- switch(input$mood,
      "Bed-Rotting" = list(
          h4("Music:"), "Isaac Dubar and Melanie Martinez",
          h4("YouTubers:"), "Smosh and Josh Johnson",
          h4("Activities:"), "Make the bed, Shower, Put on a podcast and do something mindless, Go downstairs to workout, Call Family",
          h4("Video Games:"), "Planet Crafter, Water Park Simulator, Tomodachi Life 2, Animal Crossing, Project Sekai"
      ),
      "Irritated" = list(
          h4("Music:"), "SZA, KOD - JCole, Marina, Leak it Playlist, WaterColor - Wheein",
          h4("YouTubers:"), "Girl with the Dogs, Ahzymovs",
          h4("Activities:"), "Work out, Go on a Walk, Draw",
          h4("Video Games:"), "HellDivers, Marvel Rivals, Risk of Rain 2"
      ),
      "Hyper" = list(
          h4("Music:"), "Blue and Orange Playlist, Hearts2Hearts, Jae Stephens, Pinky Up, Ice Cream EP - Yuna, Troye Sivan",
          h4("YouTubers:"), "Insym, AliensRock",
          h4("Activities:"), "work out, Go Shopping, Call Family, Play Games, Do Makeup (for no reason)", 
          h4("Video Games:"), "Planet Crafter, Tomodachi Life 2, Danganronpa (Ask Clementine to Play)"
      ),
      "Chill" = list(
          h4("Music:"), "Covid Pop Revival Playlist, WheeIn, Old Vibes Playlist",
          h4("YouTubers:"), "Insym, AliensRock, Floydson, Skottie",
          h4("Activities:"), "Take a Nap, Read, Draw, Go to the Roof and have an Existential Crisis, Watch Youtube", 
          h4("Video Games:"), "Planet Crafter, Risk of Rain 2"
      ), 
       "Anxious" = list(
          h4("Music:"), "Old Vibes Playlist, Sade, Gospel",
          h4("YouTubers:"), "Insym",
          h4("Activities:"), "Take a Nap, Read, Draw, Read a Manhwa, Go to the Roof and Stargaze and have an existential crisis, Clean Room/Apartment", 
          h4("Video Games:"), "Tomodachi Life 2, Animal Crossing"
      ) 
    ) 
    
    return(content)
  })
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)

```
While very basic, this app shows the extent of shiny app's capabilities! Using this app, I can select my mood and see my past self's recommendations for what to do, listen to, watch, or play while I feel that mood. I can also come back to this in the future and add more moods later or update the app with more recommendations in the future.
